header: Capabilities with a state against each one
lead: Shipped, in progress, planned — as a dated list rather than a marketing grid. Use it for a public roadmap, and the included checklist where the state is only yes or no.
note: The note is where the caveat about targets and commitments goes.

items.title: The state word is the editor's
items.text: It renders as a badge and can be in any language.

items.title: The dot follows the toggle
items.text: A fact rather than a string, so the colour never disagrees with the word.

items.title: Unshipped rows step back
items.text: The title drops to the secondary colour so a scan lands on what exists.
